 Court No. - 76
Bhavik Agrawal And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 September, 2025

Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and learned
A.G.A. for the State.

2. This application has been filed for quashing the charge sheet dated 9.11.2021 and cognizance
order dated 25.5.2022 passed by Civil Judge (Junior Division)/Fast Track Court, Gautam Budh
Nagar in Case No.179 of 2022, State Vs. Bhavik Agrawal and others, arising out of Case Crime
No.0093 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 406 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila
Thana, District Gautam Budh Nagar.

entities.text: State Vs. Bhavik Agrawal and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
3.  It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that before the Delhi Mediation Centre,
Karkardooma Courts, Delhi the parties have settled the matrimonial dispute subject to payment of permanent alimony of Rs.50 lacs, out of which, Rs.40 lacs has already been paid by the applicants to the opposite party no.2.

entities.text:
Delhi Mediation Centre,
Karkardooma Courts, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The remaining amount of Rs.10 lacs is being produced today by means of demand draft dated 4.9.2025 of HDFC Bank bearing number 045336, which has been handed over to learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 today in Court.
A photocopy of the same is kept on record.

4. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has accepted the aforesaid demand draft of Rs.10 lacs on behalf of opposite party no.2 and submits that he would have no objection if the criminal proceedings against the applicants are quashed in terms of the compromise entered into between the parties.
5. In view of the aforesaid, the proceedings of the aforesaid case is hereby quashed.
6. The present application is, accordingly, allowed.
